lines: Anupāya unit 20: In the shining-forth, for an unlit part, how, indeed, radiance?
l4.sanskrit_cite: praśāśe hyaprakāśāṃśaḥ kathaṃ nāma prakāśatām prakāśamāne tasminvā taddvaitāstasya lopitāḥ
